technical_scope.primary: Architecture-level rework of the candidate packer/output stage to split len_r_reg[1] -> lval/ltot -> left_shift -> cstage/accw -> cmem (11 levels, 7.578 ns) without losing one-symbol-per-cycle throughput.
required_changes: Register length/distance code and extra-bit generation (table/precompute) instead of feeding left_shift combinationally from len_r.
Split left_shift and cstage/accw into 2 pipeline stages.
Register cmem write data (and, if needed, a write FIFO) so the ERAM write path is not in the same cycle as the shift/accumulate chain.
Add a small skid/FIFO (4-8 entries) between the packer and cmem/output to absorb variable symbol lengths and backpressure.
Separate block-end/abort/commit control from the datapath; use registered flags so control does not recreate the long arithmetic path.

throughput_red_line.rule: Pipelining may add latency but must not add a per-symbol bubble. If the rework needs a multi-cycle schedule per symbol, stop and return to planner; do not trade throughput for timing.

invariants: No change to protocol, ports, frame commit, raw/xform/stream length, CRC, abort, Bayer mapping, zlib/fixed/stored format.
No change to external timing contract or TB behavior.
Full-frame P3 must prove block boundaries, backpressure, abort/reset, stored fallback and A/B semantics unchanged.

stop_conditions: P2/P3 any mismatch, X propagation, illegal BTYPE, or vlog warning -> stop before TD, return blocked.
Any throughput regression below 77.76 MB/s (P2 comp or 1080p p1d1) -> stop; do not enter TD.
S1 synthesis WNS<0 or TNS<0 -> do not route; at most one concrete architecture-fix retry (S2) and one final retry (S3) within the 3-synth cap.
S2/S3 synthesis still WNS<0 or TNS<0 -> stop; do not route; no fourth synthesis.
Synthesis WNS>=0 -> route in that same session; route must finish within the 60 min route window and the 75 min session cap.
Route not Routed, routed WNS/TNS<0, any violating endpoint, resource overflow, or CDC unsynchronized -> stop, keep logs; the single route attempt is used, no route retry.
After r5, if best WNS < -1 ns -> stop and reassess microarchitecture; do not start r6 automatically.
Any WNS<0 at the end of r5 is FAIL/blocked and does not auto-start r6.
TD budget reached (3 sessions / 150 min) -> stop; no further session in this run.
Any request to relax 187.5 MHz, add false path/multicycle, run bitgen/download, or expand scope -> stop and return to planner.

execution_limits.retry_policy: architecture-fix retries only with a concrete new critical path; no seed sweep; two consecutive no-progress attempts -> blocked

td_budget_rationale.why: Architecture-level packer/output rework needs up to three synthesis attempts to validate successive pipeline cuts, plus one route. A full session is 75 min (synth ~10 min + 60 min route); the 150 min total cap prevents three full-length route sessions. Synthesis is cheap (~1-2 min); the single route attempt is the expensive step and is gated by WNS/TNS>=0.
td_budget_rationale.history: P4 r0-r4 used 8 TD sessions (r0 2, r1 1, r2 1, r3 2, r4 2); r5 is a new explicit user budget after the 3-repair cap, not a reset of the B01 production budget.
